title: Hosted modules: staged is not live
summary: MCP, Wire browser/access-point modules and future HTTPS-hosted components share one hosted-module lifecycle. The core is protocol-neutral; each module supplies a deployment declaration, package/load probe, activation declaration and live probe.
invariants: Hosted success requires staged -> package-loadable -> composed -> activated -> live-probed.
Copy, rexxc success or fake-host unit tests do not prove live deployment.
Activation and live probing are mandatory before status can become live.
Protocol-specific route arguments, interceptors, assets and health semantics remain adapter declarations.
The same hosted lifecycle must work for MCP, Wire and later modules without core special cases.

provenance.claim: Defines common hosted-module lifecycle and protocol-neutral adapter boundary.
Executable helper refuses LIVE without load, activation and live probe.
States common hosted-module authority for MCP/Wire.
